summary: Section D passes at 98/100 across all 7 scored dimensions: the cite-renumber reconciliation is clean (all 10 inline [N, tag] pairs verified to resolve to the correct bib entry with matching enum tags), the three highest-stakes effect sizes (Almond PMID 15829535 OR 4.2/7.4, Waikar PMID 19699382 OR 1.47, Gheorghiade PMID 17309900 19.5%/3 mmol) were confirmed against PubMed and match exactly, every major cohort is named and N-annotated inline, Spasovski is correctly tagged `regulatory`, and the concentration/pseudohyponatremia/translocational interpretive-limitations layer is complete; a minor 6-point deduction on reasoning_integrity reflects the use of the older Katz glucose-correction factor (1.6 mmol/L per 5.6 mmol/L) rather than the updated Hillier figure (2.4 mmol/L per 5.6 mmol/L) noted in the Section B rubric, though this is not a Section D brief requirement and does not materially compromise the section.
